The '''Golden Jerry Artifact''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Accessory]] which can be crafted from {{Item|Purple Jerry Talisman|amount=5}}s. It grants the user {{Stat|int|-4}}. It is the final upgrade of the [[Green Jerry Talisman|Jerry Talisman]] line.

== Trivia ==
*While its debuff of {{Stat|int|-4}} might sound unattractive at first, it still grants [[Accessory Power]], and it can be [[Enrichments|Enriched]].
*To craft it, a total of {{Item|Green Jerry Talisman|amount=125}}s (or an equivalent number of [[Blue Jerry Talisman]]s or [[Purple Jerry Talisman]]s) must be combined.
*On its release, it was believed that this was obtained from [[Jerry Box|Golden Jerry Boxes]]. This was later proven false.
